title: A BasedOn chain of paragraph styles
concept: Body inherits from the [No paragraph style] root; Body Indented inherits from Body. The applied style resolves by walking the chain.

annotations.note: The root [No paragraph style] carries the document's base size and fill, and its font as a typed AppliedFont inside Properties (InDesign ignores an AppliedFont attribute). It is the bottom of every chain.
Body is BasedOn the root: it sets PointSize and SpaceAfter, and inherits the font and FillColor from the root.
Body Indented is BasedOn Body: it sets only FirstLineIndent and inherits everything else through Body to the root.
